title: Wake me in a second
summary: alarm() sends SIGALRM later; pause() sleeps until a signal arrives.
hints: `alarm(1);` asks for `SIGALRM` in one second; `pause();` returns after a handler has run. Install the handler first.
Mixing `printf` and `write` puts lines out of order, because `printf` waits in a buffer: `fflush(stdout)` after the first line.
